content.comment_body: Hello! I am using [product_name] with [product_name] [version_no]. When I log in, I can access my system, but I am unable to control the PLC from the [product_name] Basic Module interface because nothing appears on the display. Clicking on the arrows does not trigger any actions. Can someone clarify if a specific installation step is required to enable this control access? Thank you.

Did you create message texts? If so, did you select the web server option when making them? The web server only displays the interface of [product_name] or an operator device. The keys appear virtually, but they only work if incorporated into the [product_name] program. You cannot access the menu level of [product_name] through the web server; direct access is only available via the physical basic module.

Hello, and thank you for the help! I have a main program installed on [product_name] and another on a data card inserted in the PLC. Should the virtual keys of the [product_name] Basic Module on the web server work in this case? I did not create any text messages. Thanks again.
Apologies, I just verified that it is possible to control the PLC through the [product_name] Basic Module interface. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user's difficulty was with controlling a [product_name] PLC remotely using [product_name] [version_no] and the Basic Module interface. Initially, interaction was missing and control options were not visible. Subsequent responses explained that virtual controls on the web server only work if they are programmed in the application's logic, and menu access is restricted to the hardware. The issue was resolved once the user realized remote control was indeed possible, indicating the problem was due to unfamiliarity or incomplete configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have full and immediate remote control of PLC functions through the Basic Module interface in [product_name] [version_no], without needing to perform special configuration or facing usage limitations.
